coverage.note: no batting order has posted yet, so there are no hitters to rank. Orders post through the late afternoon and `hrpred players <game>` records one once it does. The biggest games below are ranked over every game that carries a λ.

views.note: the model's own ranking of every hitter it can currently see, in probability order across all the games whose lineups have posted. Nothing is filtered out before the ranking, which is what makes this the list the other two are read against.

the hitters in the day's biggest games, where a game's size is its two clubs' λ added. Narrowing to a handful of games before ranking can only lower the home runs expected from a list — every hitter it drops was rated above one it kept — so this reads the slate by matchup rather than improving on the full ranking. It is also the looser of the two filters: a game total includes the opposing club's λ, which contributes nothing to any hitter's share of his own club's.

the hitters on the day's strongest clubs, by each club's own predicted λ. Narrowing before ranking drops hitters the model rates more highly here too, so this is a way of reading the slate rather than a better list. What it does have over the matchup view is that a club's own λ is exactly the number a hitter's share is taken from.
